project1.label: Kitchen
project1.title: Japandi-style kitchen
project1.description:
A kitchen designed for every centimetre.

In this apartment we created a fully bespoke kitchen: oak veneer and solid oak, finished with Rubio Monocoat 2C oil. Countertop and wall cladding in Travertino marble. Integrated LED lighting running the full length. Oak parquet flooring matched to the cabinetry. Every element designed and crafted to fit the existing space.

project2.label:
Wine rack
cabinet
project2.title: Wine rack + TV unit
project2.description:
From drawing to finished product — all made by us.

This wine cabinet was born from scratch: the client had a complex space to make the most of — a wall, an air-conditioning unit already installed, and the need to combine a wine rack and a TV unit into a single bespoke piece. We designed it with concealed power sockets and an integrated LED lighting system, for an elegant, perfectly functional result that adapts to the existing spaces and installations.

slide3.body:
We restore furniture — bringing pieces back to life while preserving their story.

We are at home with delicate materials such as teak and rare exotic woods, choosing the right method and finish for every surface with care.

slide4.title:
Boiserie
and panelling
slide4.body:
We craft boiserie — wall panelling that gives character to an entire interior.

We work with fabric and wood, finish with oil, and master rich, expressive staining that brings out the texture and depth of the material.
